scope: Deterministic source regression and Node CPU diagnostic; NOT phone latency or live API proof

denied binder access starts neither ownership nor catalogue
ownership denial fails promptly even while public catalogue is stalled

ambiguous binder does not fetch an unrelated catalogue

indexed matcher preserves exact-ID precedence, ambiguity, aliases and consumption
indexed matcher equals the reference for 4096 mixed requests across all supported cache languages
actual screen overlaps authentication and binder lookup, then renders before optional requests settle
actual screen retains private-binder denial after overlapping reads
actual screen discards an old account result before card loading
actual screen discards a navigation result that arrives after cancellation
